title: Stop Wasabi snapshot from wiping DB3 imports
description:
DB3 Commit could report success (e.g. 36 sanitary segments added) and then those pipes vanished from PSR. Root cause: on OVH, PSR lives in Wasabi latest.json, but a background Postgres→Wasabi snapshot (and PM2 workers) could overwrite latest.json right after a successful import write, dropping the new segments.

Wasabi mutation writes now use ETag / If-Match retries, snapshots run on the same write queue and re-read freshest planner data before putting, DB3 commit skips the follow-up snapshot, and commit re-reads Wasabi to confirm segments stuck before saying success.

Who is affected: PipeSync DB3 importer / PSR on pipeshare.live (BASE, Wasabi-only planner). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh, re-commit the Diamond Trails sanitary DB3 (pick the green job again). If it still fails, the toast will say the write did not stick instead of fake success.
changeLog: Serialize Wasabi snapshots with mutation writes so imports are not clobbered.
Use S3 If-Match ETag retries on Wasabi latest.json puts across PM2 workers.
Skip follow-up state snapshot after DB3 commit/preview.
Re-read Wasabi after DB3 commit and fail clearly if segments did not stick.
